title: Debug an Error in VS Code
description: Reproduce, read, and fix a runtime error — the core loop of real software work.

steps.instruction: Open any code file in VS Code (or create one) that you can intentionally break
hints: A tiny JS/Python file is ideal — easy to reason about

steps.instruction: Deliberately introduce a bug — misspell a variable, call an undefined function, etc.
hints: The goal is to see a real error message, not crash your system

steps.instruction: Run the file and read the full error message carefully
hints: Notice: the error TYPE (ReferenceError, TypeError...), the MESSAGE, and the LINE NUMBER
Stack traces read bottom-up — the top line is where it broke

overlay.text: Read the error message top-to-bottom — don't skim

steps.instruction: Fix the bug based on what the error told you, save, and re-run
hints: If you can't tell from the message, paste it into a search engine or ask Zee
After fixing, confirm the error is gone — don't assume it worked

steps.instruction: Take 30 seconds: what did the error message teach you about your code?
hints: This habit — stopping to learn from each bug — is what turns juniors into seniors
